notes.probe: closed-form ridge from standardised DIAGNOSTIC-pooled clip vector to fixed text embedding; fit on train only; lambda by 5-fold source-video-grouped CV on train (criterion MRR); frozen/val evaluation only
notes.learned_parameters: W (d_in x d_text) + output bias (train text mean); standardisation mean/std of X from train
notes.text_primary: t5enc = pretrained t5-small encoder, mean-pooled over tokens, L2-normalised (fixed)
notes.text_secondary: tfidf = word TF-IDF, vocab (df>=2) and idf from train sentences only, L2-normalised
notes.score: cosine(predicted centred text vector, candidate text vector minus train text mean)
notes.forced_choice: 4-way; 1 correct + 3 negatives from the same eval split, never same source video or same text; random = seeded; length_matched = 3 nearest word counts (seeded tie-break); chance 25%
notes.rank_ties: expected value under random tie-breaking: rank = 1 + #higher + #tied/2; 4-way credit = 1/#tied-at-max if the correct item is among them (so a constant representation scores chance)
notes.native: frozen model decoder, teacher-forced mean token NLL, targets tokenised as in training (max_target_len 30)
